truncate table busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES

SELECT * FROM D360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL WHERE H = 'D' and acid ='PA10014487'

SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES

SELECT  STG.[BANK_ID]
,STG.[ACID]
,PREVIOUS_CURRBAL as PREVIOUS_CURRBAL
,PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL as PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL
,STG.[CURRENT_EOD_DATE] as CURRENT_EOD_DATE
,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL as ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
,ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL as ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm] as insert_dttm
FROM [D360].[STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL] STG where isnumeric(PREVIOUS_CURRBAL) = 0 and PREVIOUS_CURRBAL is not null
and H = 'D'


alter table busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES alter column PREVIOUS_CURRBAL 	numeric(18,2) --numeric(18,2) default 0;
alter table busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES alter column PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL 	numeric(18,2) --numeric(18,2) USE_TYPE_DEFAULT;
alter table busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES alter column ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL 	numeric(18,2) --numeric(18,2) USE_TYPE_DEFAULT;
alter table busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES alter column ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL 	numeric(18,2) --numeric(18,2) USE_TYPE_DEFAULT;

ALTER TABLE Employee ADD DEFAULT 'SANDNES' FOR CityBorn

select convert(decimal(18,4),PREVIOUS_CURRBAL) from d360.stg_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
-----UT 1
SELECT TABLE_NAME, 
COLUMN_NAME, 
CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'nvarchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'varchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'char' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'numeric' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'decimal' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('datetime','datetime2', 'date', 'int', 'bigint', 'tinyint', 'float', 'smallint','bit','time') THEN DATA_TYPE
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'bit' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')'
	 END AS DATA_TYPE,
	 LEFT(IS_NULLABLE,1) IS_NULLABLE			 
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES') and TABLE_SCHEMA = 'busc'
ORDER BY 1
